chunks.doc_title: Complex Adaptive Infrastructure & Cascading Grid Destabilization Dynamics
chunks.text: Modern critical infrastructure forms a multiplex network where financial clearing, energy transmission grids, and telecommunications interlock. Perturbations at high-eigenvector central nexus nodes propagate non-linearly. When transmission grid frequencies deviate outside 49.8 Hz - 50.2 Hz tolerances, automated load-shedding circuit tripwires shed tier-3 consumer loads to protect generator rotors.
